en: Bun has a vast amount of pretty useful
core APIs built into it. I mean, it has full
pretty much full Node.js compatibility, so
you can run your Node.js apps with Bun
and you can use all those third-party
packages that you may want to use there with
But Bun itself got lots of useful features
that allow you to build feature-rich web
applications, useful utility tools, and many
other things. And over the next lectures,
we'll dive into all those useful core APIs
you may not know about yet.
